text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the cheers, the Hanshin Daishoten 
drew to a close. Cheval Grand defeated 
Shine Praise— her dear childhood 
friend—and claimed victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand demonstrated her own strength 
in a long-distance race, setting herself 
apart from both her older and younger 
sisters. Both sisters praised her 
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That night, on the way back home, Cheval 
Grand dashed off toward the seaside all by 
herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Breaking free from comparisons with 
others, she finally found her own unique 
strength. Raising her voice, she swore to 
the sea that she would become the number 
one "greatest Umamusume" in the world.
